_readme: Edit this file to update the site. Counts and filters update themselves. Optional per project: "link" (repo URL) and "badge".

projects.title: Song Recommendation System
projects.description: Song recommendations powered by Grover's search algorithm. This was my main internship project.

projects.title: Real-time AI Assistant Backend
projects.description: A high-performance, asynchronous Python backend that simulates a real-time AI agent. It covers bi-directional WebSockets, LLM token streaming, complex agentic tool use and asynchronous database persistence.

projects.title: Mini-LangGraph Workflow Engine
projects.description: A lightweight, async-first backend engine for defining and executing agentic workflows. Built for an AI Engineering internship assignment.

projects.title: Product Recommendation System
projects.description: Product data lives in MongoDB. A search query, combined with the budget limit and filters the user sets, returns the k nearest matching products.

projects.title: Tripster
projects.description: Builds trip plans from a search query, in the same spirit as the product recommender but with filters like number of days and budget. Data in Supabase, locations from the Google Maps API.

projects.title: Product Price Tracker
projects.description: A continuous daily web-scrape pipeline that keeps a Supabase database up to date, with a React UI and a Python pipeline. It emails me when a price drops below the base price I set.

projects.title: Financial Tracker Using SMS
projects.description: Tracks savings, spending and current balance. MacroDroid and Tailscale trigger whenever a transaction SMS arrives. Each month it cross-checks the totals against the bank statement PDF from email.

projects.title: Gym App
projects.description: A Flutter app that scans gym equipment, names it, and lists the exercises you can do with it. It currently classifies 5 machines at 75% accuracy, and it also helps plan workouts.

projects.title: Bengali to English Translator
projects.description: A Bengali to English translator built on a BERT model from Hugging Face.

projects.title: RAG Using Llama 2
projects.description: Practice project exploring chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation.

projects.title: stackbot-agent
projects.description: Prompt-engineering practice: an agent that recommends a tech stack to junior developers for their projects, using Gemini 2.5.

projects.title: Quantum Binary Classifier
projects.description: A first quantum computing project: a binary classifier.

projects.title: Fruit and Vegetable Classifier
projects.description: Built and trained a Keras neural network to classify fruits and vegetables.

projects.title: Resume
projects.description: An ATS checker and resume builder.

projects.title: Binance Trading Bot
projects.description: An automated trade workflow for Binance.

projects.title: Crypto_bot
projects.description: Practice project on crypto mining and price prediction.

projects.title: Data Hub
projects.description: A data hub built in React, as practice.
